$comment: v2 Phase L1 rule-derived amenity-link defaults, from E1 hazard/ventilation flags, so any machine (incl. user-invented) requires sensible amenities automatically. Precedence: user override > explicit link (machine type's amenityLinks in the library) > rule-derived (below) > none. Each machine may require several amenities; nearest instance satisfies. path-based types use engine-grid walking travel (reused via the V0 seam); others use straight-line proximity. EVERY entry carries provenance (a standard clause or 'design assumption'). See v2/AMENITY_LINKS.md.

rules.provenance: NFPA 10 (2022) §6.2.1.1 (Class A extinguisher, 75 ft travel distance)
ANSI/ISEA Z358.1-2014 §4.5.2 (eyewash: 10 s / ~55 ft travel, unobstructed)
NFPA 30 / OSHA 1910.106 (flammable-liquid storage nearby); 35 ft = design assumption
OSHA 1910.94 / ACGIH (local exhaust at process); 10 ft = design assumption
NFPA 664 (dust-collection system); 30 ft duct run = design assumption
